[[/Maps|Non-interactive maps]] | ingame name=Sage Lands | game link type 0=explorable | game link num 0=041 }} The [[Sage Lands]] are the border lands of [[Kryta]] and the [[Maguuma Jungle]]. Rebels, outlaws, and ancient druids regard this place as a sanctuary from the [[White Mantle]]. {{TOCright}} == Getting there == Exit from [[Druid's Overlook]]. == Shrines == ;[[Resurrection shrine]]s: * Northeast, near the exit to [[Majesty's Rest]]. * Southeast, near the exit to [[The Wilds (outpost)|The Wilds]]. * Southwest, south of the exit to [[Mamnoon Lagoon]]. * South, near the exit to Druid's Overlook. ;[[Statue of Lyssa]] * Southeast corner. ==NPCs== These quests will affect the [[spawn]]s in this area: * [[Eye For Profit]] * [[A Brother's Fury]] * [[Wisdom of the Druids]] ===Allies=== ====Services==== *{{x}} 2 [[Aaron Fletcher]] ([[collector]] for 5 [[Ancient Eye]]s) *{{x}} 2 [[Elwynn Kirby]] (collector for 5 [[Tangled Seed]]s) ====Other allies==== * {{w}} 15 (20) [[Justiciar Thommis]] ===Charmable animals=== [[Animal]]s * {{x}} 5 [[Warthog]] ===Foes=== [[Arachnid]]s * {{r}} 16 (25) [[Maguuma Spider]] [[Devourer]]s * {{r}} 17 (25) [[Thorn Devourer]] * {{r}} 14 (24) [[Thorn Devourer Drone]] * {{n}} 17 (25) [[Fevered Devourer]] [[Plant]]s * {{r}} 19 (25) [[Redwood Shepherd]] * {{e}} 17 (25) [[Thorn Stalker]] * {{e}} 13 (24) [[Thorn Stalker Sprout]] [[Rider]]s * {{me}} 12, 17 (24, 25) [[Wind Rider]] [[Scarab]]s * {{n}} 12 (24) [[Moss Scarab]] ====Bosses==== [[Arachnid]]s * {{r}} 18 (28) [[Martus Plagueweb]] [[Devourer]]s * {{w}} 20 (29) [[Euhh Snickersnak]] * {{n}} 20 (29) [[Rotcap Mochsart]] [[Plants]] * {{mo}} 20 (29) [[Bramblehash]] * {{e}} 20 (27) [[Splinterquake]] [[Rider]]s * {{me}} 18 (28) [[Zarr MentalMelt]] [[Scarab]]s * {{n}} 18 (28) [[Drech Galumph]] == Notes == * There is a resurrection shrine close to the [[Druid's Overlook]] portal, which can lead to accidental [[zoning]]. * Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 1.8% to the Tyrian [[Cartographer]] title. *{{Vanquisher|count = 240|low = 176|high = 296}} ** [[Wind Rider]]s chain [[Cry of Frustration]] interrupting initial skill usage efficiently. Use the [[Fount Of Maguuma]] [[Environment effect|environmental effect]] to gain an advantage. ** There's a large number of [[Popup|hidden]] foes, more than the visible ones. *** [[Devourer]]s hide by the dry paths, especially in the south. *** [[Maguuma Spider]]s spawn near the bamboo-like growths. *** [[Moss Scarab]]s sometimes spawn with spiders but mostly along verdant paths, especially in the north. They use [[Verata's Gaze]] to steal minions and [[Vampiric Touch]] can be deadly if too many [[spike]] a single ally. *** Some of the popup groups may stagger their appearance, spawning some after you've already engaged the first enemies. Be aware of this and be sure to check in case any didn't aggro. {{Explorable areas in the Maguuma Jungle}} [[de:Land der Weisen]]
